# Preserved upstream notices

`xng/` contains unmodified license texts, selected crate provenance notices and
the benchmark README from the locally downloaded xng 0.21.0 source archive.
The benchmark README's original relative links refer to the upstream repository.
Its descriptions are upstream statements, not independent findings of this project.

`download-origins.json` records local archive hashes and the origin URLs recorded
by this project's downloader/packager. Some URLs select mutable branches; a hash
does not establish an immutable source revision or binary/source correspondence.
This inventory covers the listed local artifacts, not every bundled dependency.

See the root `THIRD-PARTY.md` for how these components are used and
`PUBLISHING.md` for outstanding release checks. No decoder source or binary is
vendored in this notices directory.
